headlines.title: Special Report: Engineering Focus on Motion Control
headlines.summary: The Robot Report looks at recent advances in automation for manufacturing, from improvements in technologies and use cases to the potential of humanoids and AI.
headlines.summary_tr: Bu haber, insansi robotlarin depo ve lojistik tarafinda gercek saha kullanimina gectigini gosteriyor.
headlines.why_it_matters: Robotik gercek dunyaya indiginde verimlilik, uretim yapisi ve is gucu dengesi degisir. Bu sinyal özellikle automation, humanoid ekseninde öne çıkıyor.

headlines.title: Anthropic stock wavers as rest of AI sector rallies on Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia
headlines.summary: Nvidia stock jumped 30% after Jensen Huang's reinstatement, while Anthropic stock was 6% above its $83 IPO price at 9:48 a.m. ET
headlines.summary_tr: Bu haber, Nvidia ve yapay zeka cipleri tarafinda altyapi yarisinin hiz kesmeden devam ettigini gosteriyor.
headlines.why_it_matters: YZ altyapi yarisi sermaye akislarini, cip talebini ve platform kazananlarini belirler. Bu sinyal özellikle ai, anthropic ekseninde öne çıkıyor.

headlines.title: The manufacturing data gap holding back physical AI
headlines.summary: Manufacturers looking to deploy autonomous robots must close gaps in industrial data collection, interoperability, and quality feedback to enable reliable decision-making and improve production efficiency.
headlines.summary_tr: Bu haber, robotik uygulamalarin laboratuvar asamasindan cikip gercek operasyonlara daha fazla girdigini gosteriyor.
headlines.why_it_matters: Robotik gercek dunyaya indiginde verimlilik, uretim yapisi ve is gucu dengesi degisir. Bu sinyal özellikle autonomous, robot ekseninde öne çıkıyor.
